text: You want to modify your laptop order to your NYC address (you don't want to reveal it yourself but the address should be in your orders profile). You also want to modify the laptop to item number 9844888101. You also want to change your watch for one with black dial color but keeping the leather strap.
zh: 您想修改您的笔记本电脑订单到您的纽约地址（您不想自己透露，但地址应该在您的订单资料中）。您还想将笔记本电脑修改为商品编号9844888101。您还想将您的手表换成黑色表盘但保留皮革表带。
